title: Missiles Strike Ukraine's Capital After U.S. Envoy Visits Russia
detail: The Hindu reports missiles struck Kyiv following a visit by a U.S. envoy to Russia. Casualty and damage details were not available in the feed summary.

media.caption: Missiles strike Ukraine's capital after U.S. envoy visits Russia

title: Trump Reportedly Asks Musk to Lift Starlink Restrictions in Ukraine
detail: The Wall Street Journal, as relayed by the Jerusalem Post, reports that President Trump asked Elon Musk to lift Starlink restrictions affecting Ukraine. Details of the restrictions and any response from Musk were not available in the feed summary.
